tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las// rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba bzhugs so//

dri mas dri ma gzhom mdzad pa// rdo rje 'dzin la gus byas nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las// rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba bshad| |'di la rnam pa gnyis yin te// steng sgo rnam par grol ba dang*// 'og sgo bde ba chen po gnyis// dang po steng sgo rnam grol la// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum// sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa ni// rtsa rlung thig le sbyang ba'o// dang po rtsa rnams sbyang ba la// bsam gtan chos bdun ldan pa'i dang*// rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje ni// yab yum rkyang pa gsal btab pa'i/ */spyi bo nas ni gsang ba'i bar/ */dhū ti phyi sngo nang dmar ba// yar sne tshangs bug mar sne ni// gsang bar thug pa sba lcag tsam// de g.yas ro ma dmar mo dang*// g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis// yar sne klad rgya'i steng nas ni// sna bug gnyis la zug pa la// mar sne cha dbyibs dbu mar zug /de gsum ka ba lta bu la| |gdugs rtsibs tshul gyi 'khor lo lnga// spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis// mgrin par rtsa 'dab bcu drug dang*// snying khar rtsa 'dab brgyad pa ste| |lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*// gsang bar rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis// de rnams yar sne dkar dmar dang*// mthing ser ljang ba'i rtsa 'dab la| |mar sne bde chen longs spyod dang*// chos dang sprul pa bde skyong gi// 'khor lo zhes brjod ming du btags// rtsa rnams thams cad drang ba dang*// gsal dang stong dang phra ba ste// mtshan nyid bzhi ldan tshul du bsgom// gnyis pa rlung sbyang rim pa ni// sna rlung cha mnyam rgyu la bya// me mnyam yon srong 'khrul 'khor ni// spyi ltar byas rjes mnyam rgyu'i tshe// lus gnad bsam gtan chos bdun las// lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur ni// pus steng sbrengs nas rlung ro bsal// dal gyis brngubs nas lte 'og tu// mchil mas ded la khyur gyis bskyur// lte 'og dgang zhing rgyab rlung bsdam// bum can rlung gi sbyor ba ste// bya rdzogs skad cig tshad kyis bzung*// tha ma nyer gcig 'bring lnga bcu// brgya phrag rab yin 'byongs pa'i rtags// thun dang po'o// gsum pa thig le sbyang ba ni// spyi bor 'od kyi thig le ni// stong gsal 'ja' 'dra gsal btab nas// steng rlung rngub tshe dbu mar bab// gsang gnas 'khor lo'i lte bar gnas| |bum can stong tshe yar 'ong ba// spyi bor slebs bsam rlung la sbyang*// de ltar gsum gyi thun mong du// lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor 'di lta ste// bum can rlung bzung rab gang tshe// rkang pa gnyis kyi rkyang rdeb gsum// gsang ba'i rtsa mdud grol bar byed// sked pa g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor// khu tshur g.yas g.yon lte ba'i khar| |gsum gsum brdegs pas lte ba yi// rtsa mdud grol bar byed pa yin// gru dpung g.yas g.yon phyi nang du// gsum gsum gcu zhing khu tshur gnyis// gzhog drud mchan rdeb nu ma'i khar// rdo rje'i khu tshur gsum gsum rdeg

/snying kha'i rtsa mdud grol bar byed// mgrin pa gcud skor g.yas g.yon du// gsum gsum bya zhing lag gnyis kyis// dpung rdeg gsum bya mgrin pa yi// rtsa mdud ma lus grol bar byed// mgo bo g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor// lag gnyis zhags skyur gsum byas pas// spyi bo'i rtsa mdud grol bar byed| |mgo lus med par 'phur ba dang*// rkang pa sems skyil lag gnyis kyi// zhags skyur dang bcas 'bebs gsum gyis// lus kyi rtsa mdud grol bar byed// mjug tu ha sprug byas pa yis// rtsa rnams 'chus srong man ngag yin// thun gnyis pa'o// dngos gzhi'i lam ni 'di lta ste// lha dang rtsa 'khor sngags ltar gsal// spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus| |dkar cha haṃ yig mgo thur bstan// 'phyang ba ba yi nu ma 'dra// gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i dbus// dmar cha'i dwangs ma gtum mo'i me// a shad rnam par gsal ba yang*| |rnam pa me la reg bya tsha// kha dog dmar zhing ngo bo bde// mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gsal dmigs nas// rlung rngub bum can sbyor ba'i tshe// ro rkyang rlung gis a shad sbud// me 'bar me lce snying khar slebs// haṃ dros zar bu thigs pa dang*// me la song bas tsheg sgrar bcas// cher 'bar haṃ la reg la khad// slar yang me nyid rang sar bab// 'di la 'khrul 'khor 'di lta ste// lus gnad me thab drug bcings la// rlung bzung dmigs gsal pho ba ni// g.yas g.yon gsum gsum rab tu bskor// 'phul 'then gsum gsum 'bebs gsum bya// bde drod skye ba'i 'khrul 'khor ro// thun gsum pa'o// slar yang snying ga'i rtsa 'dab kyi// dbus su buṃ dang mdun du hūm̐// g.yas aṃ rgyab dzriṃ g.yon du khaṃ// dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i mdog /mgrin pa mdun māṃ g.yas lāṃ dang*// rgyab pāṃ g.yon tāṃ sngo ser dang*// dmar ljang gsal dmigs rlung bus pas// gtum mo'i me 'bar me lce yis// snying mgrin sa bon dgu bsregs nas// haṃ la reg pas dkar cha bab// mgrin snying yi ge slar sos nas// me lce a shad la thim zhing*// dkar chas me la ma thug tsam// dar dkar dpyangs pa lta bur bsam// 'di'i tshe 'bar 'dzag 'khrul 'khor ni// lus gnad me thab drug bcings dang*// rlung bzung pho ba g.yas g.yon du// gsum gsum skor tshe me 'bar bsam// dpung pa yar la gzengs bstod tshe// me 'bar sa bon sreg par bsam// dpung pas rdeg 'tshog bgyis pa'i tshe// me smad dkar chas sa bon rnams| |gsos pas thur la dpyang bar bsam// dpung pa gzengs dbab gsum gsum bya// gru dpung phyi nang g.yas dang g.yon// gsum gsum gcu zhing 'phul 'then yang*// gsum gsum 'bebs gsum byas pa'i tshe// lus kun bde bas khyab par bsam// thun bzhi pa'o// slar yang ro rkyang rlung gis ni// gtum mo spar ba cher 'bar bas// haṃ la reg pas dkar cha bab// dkar dmar 'dres pas spyi bo yi// bde chen 'khor lo kun gang tshe// dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas// dkar cha me dang 'dres pa dag

/bab nas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang*// mchog dga'i ye shes mngon du byas// slar bab snying ga'i 'khor lo gang*// dga' bral ye shes mngon du byas// yang bab lte ba'i 'khor lo gang*// lhan skyes ye shes mngon du byas// slar bab gsang ba'i 'khor lo gang*// bde stong mngon byas mnyam par bzhag /slar yang me 'bar dkar cha de/ lte bar sleb cing rtsa gnas gang*// dga' ba'i bde ba ngos bzung bya// de bzhin snying khar mchog dga' dang*// mgrin par dga' bral spyi bo ru// lhan skyes bde ba ngos bzung zhing*// mnyam bzhag dga' bde'i ngang du bskyal// de tshe dga' bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor ni// lus gnad me thab drug bcings la// bum can rlung gi sbyor ba yis// 'dzag pa'i lugs 'byung dga' ba'i tshe// mgo bo g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor| |spyi bor dga' ba dag la dmigs// mgrin pa g.yas g.yon gsum gsum gcu// mgrin par mchog dga' dag la dmigs// gru dpung g.yas g.yon phyi nang du// gsum gsum gcu zhing snying kha ru// dga' bral ye shes ngo bor blta// pho ba g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor// lte bar lhan skyes ye shes blta// 'bebs gsum byas tshe gsang ba yi// 'khor lo'i dbus su dkar dmar brtan// slar yang pho rlung dgang dril gyis// 'bebs gsum byas tshe gsang ba nas// thig le ldog ste lte bar bzung*// pho ba g.yas g.yon gong ltar bskor// lte bar dga' ba'i ye shes dang*// gru dpung phyi nang gong ltar gcu// snying khar mchog dga' dag la blta// ske ni gong ltar gcud skor bsdam// mgrin par dga' bral ye shes bzung*// mgo bo g.yas g.yon sngar ltar bskor// spyi bor lhan skyes rang zhal blta// rtsa 'khor lnga po dkar dmar gyi// khrag dang 'o ma bsres pa yis| |rkyal grod gang ba lta bur dmigs// mnyam par bzhag cing ngal yang gso// dmigs pa 'khrul 'khor sprad la bya// thun lnga pa'o// de ltar 'khor lo kun bkang nas// 'grems pa'i dmigs rlung 'khrul 'khor ni// rdor skyil lag pa khu tshur ni// pus steng bzhag la bum can dgag

/rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yi khams// zhing la yur chu bkye ba ltar// lus kyi nang kun khengs bsam zhing*// phyi 'dzin rlung gi sbyor ba yis// seṅge rnam rol spyi ltar bya// slar yang rtsa dmigs gdab pa ni// rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang ni// lus la khrems pa'i dkar dmar rnams// 'od lnga ldan pa'i rang bzhin can// dwangs ma 'tsher zhing bkrag ldan pa// rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba yis// gos la snum gyis zhen pa ltar// lus kyi phyi nang thams cad kyi// rtsa chen rtsa phran ma lus pa// dkar dmar 'dres pa dwangs bcud ni// 'od lnga 'khrugs pas gang bar bsam// gzhil ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'di lta ste// lus gnad gong ltar bum can bzung*// khu tshur gzhog drud bzhag sha brdab// nu khar gsum rdeg 'bebs gsum bya// dpung rdeb gsum dang 'bebs gsum bya// zhags skyur gsum dang 'bebs gsum bya// mda' 'gengs drug dang 'bebs gsum bya// gzhil ba nyer bdun dmigs par bcas// zung 'jug nyams su blang bar gces// thun drug pa'o// de nas rjes kyi man ngag ni| |gtum mo bogs 'don rnam pa gnyis// bde ba dang ni drod kyis so// dang po bde ba bogs 'don ni// lus gnad rdor skyil la sogs kyi// bum can rlung gis sbar ba'i mes// haṃ la reg tshe dkar cha bab// spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo ru// thig le bcu drug cha ru gnas// slar yang gtum mo'i me sbar bas// de phyed mgrin par bab pa ni// thig le brgyad kyi cha ru gnas// slar yang rlung me sbud sbar gyis// de phyed snying khar bab pa ni// thig le bzhi yi cha ru gnas// slar yang rlung me'i sbyor ba yis// de phyed lte bar bab pa ni// thig le gnyis kyi cha ru gnas// slar yang gtum mo'i sbyor ba yis// de phyed gsang bar bab pa ni// thig le gcig gi cha ru gnas// de ltar bcu drug phyed phyed sogs| |rim gyis bri zhing bab pa'i tshe// spyi bo nas ni rim bzhin du// gti mug 'dod chags zhe sdang dang*// nga rgyal phrag dog dug lnga po// chos dbyings sor rtog me long dang*// mnyam nyid nan tan lnga ru bsgyur// gsang ba'i thig le gcig po nyid// rdo rje'i lam brgyud rtser son pa// 'pho med bcing ba'i dmigs pa la// gnad du bsnun tshe mi bzod pa// bde ba chu ltar brub pa 'byung*// de tshe bogs 'don 'khrul 'khor ni// lus gnad gong gi bum can bzung*// rdor skyil khu tshur sta zur du// sar btsugs 'bebs chen nyer gcig bya// gong gi dmigs pa dag dang sbyar// des ni bde ba mi bzod 'byung*// de tshe bde ba'i ngo bo ni// stong zhing bdag med mkha' 'dra bar// blta zhing 'bad pas sbyang bar bya/ thun mthar gsang ba'i thig le gcig po lte ba'i gcig po la yar bstim/

lte ba'i gcig po snying kha'i gnyis po la yar bstim pa sogs nas mthar spyi bo'i haṃ la bstim mo// thun bdun pa'o// gnyis pa drod la bogs 'don pa// lus gdan me thab drug bcings la// dmigs rlung sngar dang 'dra ba'i ngang*// rlung gis gtum mo'i me sbar bas// dbu ma'i nang khengs 'khor lo lnga// rim bzhin gang zhing ro rkyang brgyud// sna bug la thon rab 'bar zhing*// 'khor lo lnga nas rim brgyud pa'i// me yis lus nang ches cher gang*// ma shong dbang po'i sgo rnams dang*// ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas// me lce thon cing cher 'bar bas// lus kun me yis btums nas kyang*// cher 'bar srid rtse mnar med bar// gtum mo bde stong ye shes me// 'ur chen tsheg sgra bcas 'bar bas// nyon mongs kun bsregs bde drod du// phril phril cham cham song bsam zhing*// bde drod rang 'bar 'khrul 'khor ni// pho skor 'phul 'then gru dpung dang*// dpung pa gzengs dbab 'bebs rnams ni| |bdun bdun 'bad pas byas pa na// de'i tshe lus la rngul 'byung zhing*// bde drod me ltar 'bar ba 'byung*// gtum mo'i lang tsho ngom pa'i phyir// ras kyi bgo ba 'dir bsngags so// de ltar 'bad pas lam gyi rtags// du sogs rnam pa bcu 'char zhing*// gnyid 'thug la sogs 'od gsal zhing*// rmi lam 'dzin sprul bsgyur la dbang*| |'khor 'das chos kun sgyu mar 'char// bar do 'khrul med btsan sa zin// spros med 'pho ba shugs kyis 'grub// gtum mo dag la gnad bsnun pas// 'od gsal la sogs gzhan lnga po// ma bsgom shugs kyis 'byung ba ni// lam zab 'di yi khyad chos yin// de tshe 'od gsal la sogs pa// rim gyis mngon du gyur pa na// bla mas ngo sprod bslab bya gces// thun brgyad pa'o// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa yi// rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba las// steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i lam// gang zag zhe sdang gti mug dag

/che la gnad 'dis grol bar gdams// / /gnyis pa chags pa can don du// 'og sgo bde chen pho nya'i lam// gnad gdams yang zab 'dir bshad kyi// log rtog spongs shig skal ldan tshogs// gal te lam 'dir zhugs zin nas// zab mo'i lam la skur zhing gshe// thos nas log par rtogs pa dang*// gnyis 'dzin the tshom can rnams kyi// srog gi dbang po snying khrag bcas// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa mchog /bsrung bar khas blangs tshogs rnams kyis// zhal du bzhes shig sa ma ya// 'di la sngon 'gro sbyang ba dang*// dngos gzhi las la sbyar ba'o// dang po dbu ma ka 'dzugs sbyang*// 'byongs nas rdo rje'i bug pa ru// pi pi'am pi pi med kyang rung*// rlung bcug 'byongs nas chu la sbyang*// chu nyid rim gyis 'drongs pa na// 'o ma dang ni khrag la bslab| |de dag 'byongs shing rkang tshugs nas// dngos gzhi la yang rnam pa gnyis// rang lus gzhan lus thabs ldan no// dang po rang lus thabs ldan la// dbab 'dzin ldog 'dren 'grems pa dang*// rtsa mig gdab pa rnams drug go// dang po ni/ rang lus bde ba'i rdo rje'i sku// rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la sogs// sngar ltar gsal gdab gsal snang 'don// 'di la gtum mo sgom mi 'tshal// rang gi lag g.yas stong nyid kyi// rdo rje mar gsal yab yum gyi// gnas kyi lha rnams sgrub thabs ltar// gsal btab g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga// stong nyid rdo rje'i bha gar bsam// dal gyis bsgrengs shing bskyod nas kyang*// bde ba g.yo tshe cung zhig bzhag /slar bskyod bde 'bar mi bzod cing*// lugs 'byung dga' bzhi'i ngo bor blta// 'chor la nye tshe mtheb srin bsdam// gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i man ngag ni/ */rtsa them rkang rting g.yon pa ni// rtsa chen 'og gi rtsar mnan cing*// g.yas rting rtsa chen steng nas mnan// rlung them pho rlung dgang dril bya// gsum pa ldog pa'i man ngag ni// pho rlung dgang dril rgyu ma'i zhabs// sgal tshigs la sbyar mig gyen bsgrad// slar yang hika ces rlung phyir 'dzin// des ni thig le gyen du ldog

/bzhi pa 'dren pa'i man ngag ni// lag pa khu tshur mdun du btsugs// 'phongs bteg dbu ma ka 'dzugs dang*// nywa bzhi'i sha bsgrims mig gyen ldog /ka 'dzugs gyen 'then drag po dang*// mjing par shugs bskyur sked pa nyag /des ni gyen la me ltar ldog /lugs ldog dga' bzhi'i ngo bor blta// lnga pa 'grems pa'i man ngag ni// khu tshur pus bzhag rdor skyil bya// bum can rlung bzung g.yas g.yon du// gcu ba gsum gsum 'bebs gsum dang*// ha sprug gsum bya des 'grems 'gyur| |drug pa rtsa mig gdab pa ni// lus gnad gong dang 'dra ba la// bum can rlung bzung sked pa ni// g.yas dang g.yon du gsum gsum bskor// langs nas khu tshur gzhog drud cing*| |mchan rdeb sdigs mdzub nam mkhar bsgreng*// rkang g.yon brla g.yas steng du bzhag /khu tshur nu khar bsnol ba dang*// rkang g.yas brla g.yon steng bzhag pa'i// 'bebs gsum dus gcig bya ba gsum// des ni rtsa mig kun tu gzhil// de ltar rang lus thabs ldan ni// 'bad med 'byongs shing dbang thob nas// gnyis pa gzhan lus thabs ldan mchog |las kyi phyag rgya'i lam bzang gis// myur du zung 'jug bsgrub pa ni// padma can la sogs pa yi// phyag rgya mchog ldan bsten rung ba// thabs kyis bkug cing 'dris byas la| |dbang gis smin zhing theg gsum gyi// chos kyis de rgyud legs par sbyangs// rim gyis theg pa che la sbyar// gsang sngags lam mchog rim gyis bstan// de la 'dris shing goms pa na// bskyed rdzogs lam gyis grol bar bya// de nas thabs lam sngon 'gro ni// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga// dang po gzugs la bslab pa ni// dben par phyag rgya'i lang tsho la| |blta zhing gcer bur phyung nas kyang*// de yi bha ga la sogs kyi// gzugs la blta zhing 'dris par bya// gnyis pa sgra ni phyag rgya dang*// gtam gleng chags pa'i gtam mang bya// gzhan yang thabs lam zab chos kyi// yid ches gtam gyis spro ba bskyed// gsum pa dri ni phyag rgya yi// lus kyi dri ma la sogs pa// snom zhing 'dris zhen dag la 'bad// bzhi pa ro ni phyag rgya la// tsumba na bya ro 'dzin gzhib// de sogs bde ba bslang bar bya// lnga pa reg byar bslab pa ni// reg pa'i gnas dgur sen mo gdab// 'khyud dang 'o bya bo la yi// ka ko la der reg pa sogs// bde ba g.yo ba'i thabs la 'bad// de ltar lnga la bslab pa'i tshe// 'jig rten rang gi zhen rtog spangs// 'dzin med ngang nas rol cing spyad// des ni phal pa'i 'dod chen ltar// spyod pa gyi na ltar snang yang*// 'dris shing zhen par ma byas na// lam dngos nyams su blang ba'i tshe// ngo tsha'i rnam pas rlung rtsol dang*| |'khrul 'khor la sogs g.yel ba na// sa bon nyams shing dam dral nas// dmyal ba rin gyis nyos pa mang*// de phyir sngon 'gro lnga la bslab// sngon 'gro tshags su tshud pa na| |gnyis pa lam gyi dngos gzhi ni// mi med dben pa'i sa phyogs su// yid 'ong bkra shis gnas gtsang la// rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis bcag pa na// grub thob gong ma'i sgrub gnas sogs| |byin rlabs chags shing bag dro ba// mkha' 'gro 'du sogs gnas rnams su// sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan po bzung*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong bcas la gtor ma 'bul// 'dod chags lam du lhong ba yi// gsol ba btab cing 'dun pa btang*// tshogs 'khor sātstsha chu gtor dang*// lam 'phrang bcos dang sbyin gtong sogs// bsags sbyang grub tshad 'bad nas bya// lam dngos rnam pa gnyis yin te// rang don rigs rgyud mi 'jog dang*// gzhan don sprul sku 'jog pa'o// dang po ni// 'dod chags tha mal 'dzin rtog spang*| |'dod khams pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang nyes pa'i gzhi thams cad 'dod chags yin pas 'dod chags lam du lhong zhing*/

thabs khyad par can 'di la brten nas zag med ye shes mngon du byed cing bha ga'i lha tshogs rnams dang dngos su mjal zhing byin rlabs zhu ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can 'dod chags can rnams kyi 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag nas/ bla ma bde ba'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la 'god par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed// rang nyid bla ma bde ba'i rdo rje gsang sgrub ltar dang*/ rig ma stong nyid rdo rje mar bskyed la/ yab yum gyi gnas gsum 'dod lnga'i lha rnams kyang yab yum so sor gsal btab/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang ye shes pa spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams kyang gsang sgrub ltar byas rjes/ yab kyi gsang ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan zhing bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan zhing bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa yab yum gnyis kas dmigs so| |skabs 'di'am ni gzhan du'ang rung*// rang gi lce'am srin lag gis// rdzas ldan rtsa sne btsal nas kyang*// rnyed tshe mi 'gyur gzer gyis gdab// rtsa kha kha mu kha zhes bya ba phag pa'i ze ba 'dra zhing*/ g.yas dang g.yon du 'khyil ba de'ang dung dang*/ padma dang*/ ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu sogs ni bzang zhing*/ sog le dang*/ gra phub dang*/ khong stong can sogs ngan pas brtags nas rigs shes par byas la/ de dang bstun pa'i nyams len gyi gnad ka ma log par bya dgos so// de nas yab yum mkha' gsang sprad// 'khyud cing snyoms par 'jug pa ni// rus sbal 'gros sam bu chen po// lta bu gang rung gnad du gces// yab yum 'khyud sbyor la zhugs tshe// gnas gsum 'dod lnga'i lha rnams kyang*// yab yum ji bzhin snyoms 'jug bsam// yum gyi pad nang gsang sngags kyi// lha rnams khrom 'tshogs lta bu ru// bzhugs par snyoms 'jug bgyid pa'i tshe// rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub sems// bde ba'i bdud rtsis mchod par bsam// cung zad bskyod pas bde ba g.yo// de ni dga' ba'i ye shes te// ngo bo stong pa'i rang zhal blta// slar bskyod bde ba 'bar ba na// de ni mchog dga'i ye shes te// gnyis med stong pa'i rang zhal blta// slar bskyod bde ba cher 'bar tshe// de ni dga' bral ye shes te// mnyam yangs dngos po'i rang zhal blta// slar bskyod bde ba rab 'bar zhing*// mi bzod bde bas lus khyab nas// thig le nor bu'i rtser son tshe// lhan skyes ye shes zhes bya ste// 'dzag med bde chen rang zhal blta// de tshe 'dzin dang ldog pa dang*| |'dren dang 'grems dang rtsa mig gdab// de rnams rang lus ji bzhin bya// des kyang bde ba 'chor srid na// 'dzin pa rgya mtsho gnas 'ching dang*// ldog pa rdo rje'i sgyogs chen dang*// 'dren pa lcags kyu khong sgril dang*// 'grems pa stobs chen 'khor lo dang*// rtsa mig gdab pa ches zab pa// gyad bzhi ar gtad ces bya ste// man ngag 'khrul 'khor rnam lnga la// gnad kyi rlung sbyor rnam lnga gces// de la dmigs pa'i ngar 'dogs lnga// yang zab 'di rnams thugs la gab// de ltar lugs 'byung dga' bde bzhi| |'byongs nas lugs ldog dga' ba sogs// rang lus skabs ltar bslab par bya// kun la 'jig rten spyi lugs kyi// chags bde phal pa la mi sems// bde ba'i ngo bo stong pa nyid// stong pa'i ngo bo zung du 'jug

/zung 'jug ngo bo gnyis med pa// bde stong zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi// ye shes ngang las mi 'da' ba// chags lam kun gyi dam tshig yin// gal te de las 'da' srid na// ngu 'bod dmyal ba nyams su myong*// de bas de la gzab par bya// gnyis pa gzhan don bsgrub pa ni// rigs rgyud 'jog pa 'di bstan te// gnas dang sngon 'gro gong ltar la// dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bla mar bcas// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen gyis// mchod cing 'dod don gsol ba gdab// yig brgya 'don cing sems bskyed bya// bde ba lam du lhong ba dang*// bar chad mi 'byung gsol ba btab// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rgyas par bsgom// dus ni yum gyi ru dhī ra// chad rjes dus tshes gza' skar sogs// bzang zhing bde ba la bab tshe// bdag dang phyag rgya bde ba gsum// sems su shes shing bde ba de'i// phung khams skye mched lha thams cad// dran zhing mchod bstod bde stong ni// lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par bya// bde ba spang bya nyon mongs lnga// dag nas lhan skyes ye shes dngos// rtogs par bya zhing bde ba des// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can gyis// lhan skyes ye shes rtogs pa dang*// sprul pa'i sku mchog rigs bzhag nas// 'gro don dpag med sgrub pa dang*// sems can 'di dag thams cad kyang*// bde ba'i zhing du drang bar bya'o// snyam du sems bskyed yab yum mkha'// byin rlabs lha bskyed la sogs pa// rang lus ji bzhin gsal bar bsgom// khyad par yum mngal gzhal yas khang*// de nang gang 'dod lhag pa'i lha// bskyed pa'i thugs ka'am zhal dag tu// mchod par dmigs shing mkha' gsang gi// lha yi thugs las 'od 'phros pas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas kyi// thugs rje'i ye shes kun bkug nas// 'od kyi rnam par mkha' gsang thim// de dang byang sems 'dres pa las// rgyal ba'i thugs rje las grub pa'i// gzhan don sprul pa'i rigs rgyud ni// mtshan dper ldan pa grub dmigs nas// dwangs ma bul gyis btang ba'i mjug

/smon lam gdab cing shis pa brjod| |mngal sgor rang gi lhag pa'i lha// gang yin de yi las kyi lha// gsal bar bskyed pas mngal sgo srung*// de lta'i tshul ni tho rangs bya// de ltar rigs rgyud 'jog pa'i thabs| |rtsa rlung so sor ma gsungs kyang*// kun gyi snying po 'di yin no// rigs rgyud mi 'jog thabs lam la// rang dang rig ma lha'i 'du shes// mkha' gsang yig 'bru sngags 'du shes| |thabs 'dis 'dod chags rab sbyangs nas// bde chen thob pa chos 'du shes// de ltar 'du shes gsum ldan ni// chags lam mchog 'di'i rtsa ba ste// chags pas chags pa sbyong byed pa// dri mas dri ma dag pa bzhin// bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di 'phags so// gzhan phan rigs rgyud 'jog pa'i tshe// rang dang rig ma bde stong gi// ye shes ngo bo chos kyi sku// rang dang rig ma lhar bskyed cing*// mkha' gsang sngags bcas longs spyod rdzogs// mngal sgor rgyal ba'i thugs rje bsdus// rigs rgyud sa bon gdab pa ni// mtshan dper ldan pa'i sprul sku ste// de ltar sku gsum 'du shes pa// rigs rgyud 'jog tshe dmigs pa'i mchog /de ltar gsang sngags thabs zab mo// sku gsum las byung gzhan don du// rigs kyi sprul skur bsgrub pa na// bstan dang 'gro la sman pa 'di// rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin// rjes su dam tshig bsrung tshul ni// steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i lam// gtum mo tsaṇḍa lī yi ni// dam tshig du ni pus 'khyud kyi// sgom thag dmar po dra mig ma// tshad ldan lhag gnas byas pa bcang*// gzhan yang me dang nyi ma la// cher mi bsreg cing rngul mi dbyung*// chu mi brgal zhing dung mi 'bud// zwa tshod la sogs sngo rjen dang*// kha tsha rul sogs zas mi bza'// rtag tu 'khyag pa'i snang ba spang*// 'og sgo bde ba chen po zhes// chags lam mchog gi dam tshig tu// rtag tu bud med la mi smod// khams srung sngo rjen kha tsha dang*// rul sungs sga g.yer la sogs pa// khams la gnod pa'i bza' btung spang*// rtag tu thig le spel ba yi// rdzas sman sngags kyi thabs la 'bad// 'jig rten rang ga'i chags rtog spang*// lam zab ma thob gzhan dag la// tshig don dmigs pa 'khrul 'khor sogs| |gsang zhing sba ba gnad che'o// rig ma mtshan ldan ma gtogs pa// bud med rigs ngan 'dre mo dang*// yugs sa rabs chad dme can dang*// mdze sogs nad can rgas 'khog dang*// dam nyams log lta can la sogs// de 'dra'i bud med rtag tu spang*// dbang gis smin par ma byas pa'i// rig ma bsten na dam tshig nyams// de sogs lam gyi dam tshig rnams// gces par bsrung ba gnad che'o// steng 'og rnam grol bde chen gyi// pho nya'i lam bzang zab mo 'di// gzhan las ches cher bka' gnyan pas// dam tshig srung zhing nyams len gces// dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu mchog

/thob na dgos 'dod 'bad med 'byung*// ma thob 'on kyang dug sbrul gyis// rang nyid za bar tshegs med pas// khe nyen che ba dang mtshungs kyi// pho nya'i lam 'di nyams len tshe// dam ldan nyams len gnad song na// tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang 'thob cing*// dam nyams nyams len go log na// tshe 'dir mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad dang*// phyi ma dmyal bar ltung nges pas// de ltar skyon yon la bsams nas// gzab par 'tshal lo rjes 'jug rnams// de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi// steng 'og zab chos pho nya'i lam| |myur zhing zab las ches zab 'di// klu sgrub 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi// gsung gi gsang ba ji bzhin las// chad cing lhag dang nor 'khrul gyi// dri ma'i tshogs rnams ring spangs nas// ma bskyud blo yis bkod pa 'di// skal ldan 'ga' la phan pa'i blos// 'bri gung skyu ra'i rigs son pa// chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas// sbyar ba'i dge ba gang mchis pa// 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
